feat(converters): add UML Component + Deployment JSON↔BUML converters

Implements 02-component-deployment-converters-guide.md against the locked
metamodels (0b29bfd0 Component, e6df7179 Deployment). Both directions are
symmetric and round-trip identity holds on the four D7 fixtures (two real
WME exports, two hand-built reference snapshots covering the agentic
profile and multiplicity paths that the real exports don't exercise).

Helpers (shared by both directions):

* services/converters/stereotype_tokens.py — case-insensitive token
  resolution with the empty-stereotype guard (key-absent vs ""), silent
  consumption of Apollon decorative defaults ("component", "subsystem",
  "node"-via-typed-slot), AgentCategory/Locality/NodeKind/AgenticEdgeKind
  resolution, and the AgenticEdge "{permission: scope1, scope2}" suffix
  parser/formatter (Q1=a, byte-stable sorted on emit).
* services/converters/multiplicity_format.py — strict-regex parser
  (Q4) and formatter for the [N] / [N..M] / [N..*] artifact-name
  suffix; default Multiplicity(1, 1) round-trips with no suffix.

Constants:

* constants/constants.py — element-type + relationship-type dicts and
  the token sets for both diagram types. One source of truth for the
  four converter files.

Processors (JSON → BUML, three-pass: nodes, containment, relationships):

* json_to_buml/component_diagram_processor.py — Subsystem-via-owner
  containment, Component→Skill/Tool subtype promotion via stereotype,
  AgenticEdge dispatch on ComponentDependency edges, model-level
  Permission dedup-by-scope.
* json_to_buml/deployment_diagram_processor.py — Node/Artifact/
  Interface emission, synthetic Artifact(manifests=[id]) for
  DeploymentComponent (D12), DeploymentAssociation discrimination on
  endpoint types (§3.6.1), owner-link vs explicit-edge dedup with
  layout["wme_origin"] preservation.

Converters (BUML → JSON):

* buml_to_json/component_diagram_converter.py — id_for() reusing
  layout["id"], deterministic walk via sort_by_timestamp, compact
  field-emission style (matches real-export wire shape), AgenticEdge
  re-emits as ComponentDependency + stereotype string.
* buml_to_json/deployment_diagram_converter.py — multiplicity suffix
  on artifact name (first-relation-by-timestamp wins on divergence per

  in-scope element types:

    legality table.

message:
refactor(metamodel): split agentic profile into uml_component/agentic.py

Extract the collaborative-agent-swarm stereotype profile out of the base
UML Component metamodel into a dedicated extension module, mirroring the
BPMN track's bpmn/bpmn.py (base) + bpmn/agentic.py (extension) split.
The base metamodels are now pure UML 2.5 modelling; the agentic notation
is a separately citable layer. Reverses 01- decision D11 ("everything is
a Component", agentic inline) and amends D3 (typed-slot carriers split).

Metamodel:
- New besser/BUML/metamodel/uml_component/agentic.py holds the agentic
  vocabulary: AgentCategory / AgenticEdgeKind enums; AgenticComponent
  (a Component carrying agent_category / is_human / process_model_refs);
  Skill / Tool (capability Component subclasses); Permission; AgenticEdge;
  and AgenticComponentModel (a ComponentModel that owns the permissions
  collection and the agentic validation rules).
- uml_component.py is now pure UML 2.5: base Component loses the three
  agentic fields; Skill / Tool / Permission / AgenticEdge and the two
  enums are gone; ComponentModel.validate() keeps only the base
  structural checks (E1-E4, E11, E13, W7).
- __init__.py re-exports both modules, so
  `from besser.BUML.metamodel.uml_component import *` is unchanged for
  every downstream caller.
- The split simplifies validation: "is an agent" is now the
  AgenticComponent type, so the old runtime errors E5..E9 collapse into
  construction-time AgenticEdge._check_endpoint type rules; W6 (Skill /
  Tool misusing agent fields) is deleted outright -- base Component has
  no agent fields to misuse. The genuinely model-level checks (E10
  permission membership, E12 scope, W1/W2/W3 agentic smells) live in
  AgenticComponentModel.validate(), which overrides the base and appends
  them; _all_elements() is overridden so a GRANTED edge's Permission
  target resolves under the base E1 reachability check.
- Locality stays in the base metamodels (uml_component + uml_deployment)
  with a clarified docstring: it is a BESSER general profile addition
  (NR-5), neither vanilla UML 2.5.1 (no «external» standard stereotype,
  no locality concept -- verified against uml-2-5-1-formal-17-12-05)
  nor agentic, so it belongs with the base.

Converters:
- stereotype_tokens.py gains stereotype_has_agentic_tokens(); the
  agent_category / is_human setters and the format helper guard on
  isinstance(component, AgenticComponent).
- component_diagram_processor.py builds an AgenticComponent when an
  agent-category or human-actor token is present, and an
  AgenticComponentModel when the diagram carries any agentic element.
- component_diagram_converter.py needs no change: AgenticComponent /
  AgenticComponentModel satisfy the isinstance checks as subclasses.
  The WME wire shape (stereotype strings) is unchanged.

Builders:
- component_model_builder.py emits AgenticComponent and dispatches the
  model class (ComponentModel vs AgenticComponentModel) by type; agent
  fields and the permissions step are guarded for the base case.

Tests:
- New tests/BUML/metamodel/uml_component/test_agentic.py covers the
  extension; test_uml_component_metamodel.py is base-only with a
  regression guard that base Component has no agentic fields; conftest,
  converter and builder tests updated for the split.
- Full sweep green: 1270 passed, 9 skipped, 3 xfailed. Ruff CI ruleset
  clean on the changed tree.

Project files exported with a flat layout (classes, relationships,

  restore the project name/description/owner from the wrapper.

  back through the priority order if the active diagram is empty.

regression guard.

subject: feat(bpmn): allow Participant (pool) endpoints on MessageFlow
message:
feat(bpmn): allow Participant (pool) endpoints on MessageFlow

The Web Modeling Editor draws agentic collaboration message flows pool-to-pool
(Participant -> Participant), but base MessageFlow._check_endpoint accepted only
Activity/Event endpoints, so the JSON->BUML converter silently dropped every
pool-to-pool message flow on import (including agentic ones). BPMN 2.0.2 §9.3
permits a message flow to attach to a Pool directly, so relax the endpoint rule
to accept Participant.

Two validation adjustments follow from the wider endpoint type:
- _all_elements() now includes the collaboration's participants, so the
  endpoint-reachability check does not flag a pool endpoint as absent.
- _participant_of() resolves a Participant endpoint to itself, so the
  cross-pool check still catches a self-pool message flow.

The converter needs no change -- once the endpoint check passes, the flow is
constructed and attached to the collaboration as before.

Drafted with Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context).

feat(bpmn): emit agentic task/gateway/message-flow fields in BPMN XML

metamodel and the Web Modeling Editor's export:

- AgenticGateway emits a sibling <agentic:governance> child carrying the

- AgenticMessageFlow now emits its own extensionElements block (collaborationMode

feat(bpmn): add swarm-size multiplicity to «AgenticLane»

«AgenticLane» gains a `multiplicity` integer — the swarm size, i.e. how
many identical copies of the lane's agent participate in the process
(default 1, no upper cap). It is validated as int >= 1 in the metamodel
and round-tripped across every editor-facing surface:

- metamodel: `_validate_multiplicity` + field/property/setter/__repr__
- json -> buml: `_clamp_multiplicity` bridges the editor's tolerant data
  (clamps to >= 1); always read on the agentic-lane branch
- buml -> json: always emitted (default 1), matching the editor which
  serialises it on every swimlane
- .bpmn XML generator and code builder: emit only when > 1 (absence
  reconstructs the default), keeping single-agent lanes terse

Mirrors the existing trust_score plumbing, with two deliberate deltas:
the range is >= 1 / default 1, and the XML + code builder gate emission
on > 1.

subject: feat(uml_component): add LLM, Database, RAG as Tool subclasses
message:
feat(uml_component): add LLM, Database, RAG as Tool subclasses

Extends the agentic Component profile with three capability subclasses
that the WME BPMN-to-Component derivation emits when an agent state body
carries replyType 'llm', 'db_reply', or 'rag'.

LLM, Database and RAG each subclass Tool. Because AgenticEdge[USES]
already enforces "target must be a Tool", the uses edges from an agent to
any of the three new types validate with no change to the edge rules.

Without these classes the converter silently dropped those edges: the
Component would degrade to a bare Component (unknown token), then
AgenticEdge construction would raise a TypeError at the endpoint check,
which _build_relationships would catch and discard. The new map-driven
dispatch in the processor instantiates the right subclass and the edges
survive.

subject: refactor(bpmn): drop collaboration_mode, merging_strategy, and AgenticMessageFlow
message:
refactor(bpmn): drop collaboration_mode, merging_strategy, and AgenticMessageFlow

The BPMN agentic extension is simplified to match the Web Modeling Editor's
current wire format, which no longer carries these fields:

- `collaboration_mode` removed from both `AgenticTask` and `AgenticGateway`.
- `merging_strategy` removed from `AgenticGateway` (the merge axis now lives
  exclusively in the governance DSL, which is preserved as-is).
- `AgenticMessageFlow` class removed entirely; `isAgentic=True` message flows
  are silently downgraded to the base `MessageFlow` on import.

The `CollaborationMode` and `MergingStrategy` enums and all INV-A / INV-B
setter invariants are gone with them, leaving `AgenticGateway` with a
simpler signature: `gateway_role`, `trust_score`, and `governance_dsl`.

The JSON converters are now tolerant of legacy diagrams that still carry
`collaborationMode` / `mergingStrategy` keys — those fields are silently
ignored rather than raising a `ConversionError`.

Kept intact: `gatewayRole`, `trustScore`, `role`, `reflectionMode`,
`multiplicity`, `agentDiagramRef`, and the `<agentic:governance>` CDATA
extension round-trip.

subject: fix(converter): bake render-accurate class box geometry
message:
fix(converter): bake render-accurate class box geometry

class_buml_to_json baked a flat 100px height and a flat 40px header
offset for every class, regardless of member count or stereotype. The
editor masks this by reflowing the model on import, but the headless SVG
endpoint feeds the baked geometry to ELK and then renders boxes at their
true size — so downward edges hung ~30px below the box bottom and
«abstract»/«enumeration» attributes overlapped the taller stereotype
header.

Mirror the renderer (UMLClassifier): header = 50 for stereotyped
(abstract class / enumeration) else 40, height = header + 30 per
attribute/method, members start at the header. OCL constraint boxes keep
their legacy sizing; round-trips with saved layout bounds are unaffected.
